jobs.title: E-commerce Analyst
jobs.summary: Track and analyse marketplace and online sales performance, build weekly reports and turn the numbers into clear recommendations for the account teams.
requirements: 1–3 years in digital marketing, e-commerce or analytics
Clear written English; French is a plus

questions.text: A product page had 2,000 sessions and 50 orders last week. What is its conversion rate?
A campaign spent Rs 10,000 and generated Rs 45,000 in sales. What is its ROAS?
You need to bring each product's price from another sheet into your report, matching on the SKU. Which Excel function is best suited?
Sales of one best-selling product dropped 30% week on week while the rest of the account is stable. What do you check first?
options: Stock availability and whether the listing is still active and in the Buy Box

questions.text: Which marketplaces or e-commerce platforms have you worked on (e.g. Amazon, Cdiscount, Shopify), and what exactly did you do on them?
Describe a report or dashboard you built: which metrics it showed, who used it, and what decision came out of it.

jobs.title: Senior E-commerce Analyst
jobs.summary: Own the performance analysis for retail and marketplace accounts, guide optimisation decisions and support junior analysts.
requirements: 3+ years in e-commerce, retail media or performance marketing
Comfortable presenting to clients and stakeholders

questions.text: An account made Rs 300,000 in revenue from 1,200 orders. What is the average order value?
On Amazon Ads, a campaign spent Rs 2,000 and generated Rs 10,000 in ad sales. What is its ACoS?
Budget and impression share are stable, clicks are stable, but ROAS has fallen for three weeks. What is the most likely explanation to investigate first?
options: The ads are not being shown enough
Conversion rate has dropped (price, stock, reviews or product page content)
Reporting is broken, so ignore it

questions.text: A client asks how many of the sales were really caused by advertising. Which approach answers this best?
options: Compare this month with last month
Run a holdout or geo test with a control group

questions.text: You manage the same brand on three marketplaces with one monthly budget. How would you split it at the start of the month, and what would make you move money mid-month?
Tell us about a time you coached a junior colleague or presented results to a client. What happened and what did you learn?

jobs.title: E-commerce / Catalog Manager
jobs.summary: Manage product listings and content across online retailers and marketplaces, keep catalogues accurate and improve how products show up in search.
requirements: Experience managing online catalogues or marketplace listings

questions.text: What matters most for a product to show up in a marketplace's search results?
options: Relevant keywords in the title and complete product attributes

questions.text: A cream is sold in 30 ml, 50 ml and 100 ml. How should it be set up on a marketplace?
options: One parent listing with three size variations
One listing with all sizes in the description
Only list the most popular size

questions.text: A listing suddenly shows as suppressed or inactive. What is the best first step?
options: Delete it and create a new one
Check the listing quality report for missing or invalid required attributes or images
Wait for it to come back by itself

questions.text: Which is a typical main-image requirement on major marketplaces?
options: Lifestyle photo with text and logos
Pure white background with the product filling most of the frame
Any background as long as it is high resolution

questions.text: How would you keep a catalogue of 1,000+ products accurate across several retailers? Describe your process and the tools you would use.
Write a marketplace product title (in French or English) for: moisturising cream, 50 ml, brand "Exemple", for dry skin.
What kind of role are you looking for, and in which area (e.g. media, e-commerce, data, creative)?
What are your two or three strongest skills? Give a concrete example for one of them.
